info.name: Spaceship.com Async Operations DNS records API

params.name: domain
params.description: The domain whose resource records are being fetched.

params.name: take
params.description: Number of response items per page

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of response items to skip

params.name: orderBy
params.description: Specifies fields and order to sort the response items

items.docs: Retrieves a paginated list of resource records, allowing the use of query parameters to customize the response. This operation is essential for efficiently managing large collections of resource records, enabling smooth navigation and retrieval without overloading the system with unnecessary data. ### Required Permissions - dnsrecords:read ### Rate Limits * The limit for getting the domain resource records list is 300 requests per user, within 300 se

params.name: domain
params.description: The domain whose resource records are being updated.

items.docs: Add custom DNS resource records or update TTL. Records are matched using case-insensitive comparison, except for TXT records. ### Required Permissions - dnsrecords:write ### Rate Limits * The limit for saving resource record details is 300 requests per user, per domain, within 300 seconds.

params.name: domain
params.description: The domain whose resource records are being deleted.

items.docs: Delete custom DNS resource records. Records matched using case-insensitive comparison, except for TXT records, which are case-sensitive. ### Required Permissions - dnsrecords:write ### Rate Limits * The limit for deleting resource record details is 300 requests per user, per domain, within 300 seconds.
